verdict.rationale: Google Drive offers a first-party REST API (v3) that lets clients access and bulk-modify files programmatically without the UI, which gives some headless automation capability. The evidence never documents CI usage, non-interactive authentication, or a first-party CLI; authorization is described only as OAuth scopes configured in the Cloud console, and rclone is a third-party workaround that earns no credit. Missing for 10: documented non-interactive/service-account auth for CI, first-party CLI or CI integration guidance, independent corroboration of headless CI use.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can run the product headlessly / in CI for automation

citations.quote: The Google Drive API allows clients to access resources from Google Drive.
To authorize your app, the Google Drive API requires you to define OAuth scopes in two places: the Google Cloud console and your app.
